caption:
Picture a trading research floor with nobody sitting on it.
 
The setup behind this viral post runs six Grok Bots with one job each: one scans the market, one hunts setups, one reads the news, one follows the big wallets, one checks the risk. A swarm of 300 smaller agents does the digging, and a lead bot only messages the owner when a trade needs a yes or a no.
 
It is research and alerts, not a money printer. The human still approves every move.
 
Comment GROKBOT and I’ll send you the build guide.
 
#grok #aiagents #aitrading #xai #aiautomation
transcript: Someone connected 350 Grok bots to run a one-person trading desk. Picture a hedge fund's research floor, with nobody sitting on it. The setup behind that post runs six Grok bots, with one job each, and hands the grunt work to a swarm of 300 smaller agents. One scans the market all day, one hunts for setups, one reads the news and what people are saying about it, one follows where the big wallets are moving money, and one only asks, what could go wrong here? Then a lead bot collects all of it, and only pings the owner when something needs a yes or a no. No analysts on payroll. Nobody staring at charts at 3 in the morning, the bots pass notes to each other around the clock and the ideas you barely open it. Comment Grok bot, and I'll send you the build guide.
